title: ServiceM8 Review (2026)
intro: ServiceM8 is evaluated here as project management & productivity software — ServiceM8 is field service management software for trades and contractors — job scheduling, dispatch, quotes, invoicing, and mobile apps for technicians. Published pricing (2026-08-19): Free (1 user), Growing $29/mo, Premium $79/mo, Premium Plus $149/mo per company. Scored as PM/field-service job — not generic tech PM. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s project-management methodology (ease of use, work planning, automation, collaboration, integrations, reporting, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose ServiceM8 when field service scheduling and invoicing is the job.
verdict: Choose ServiceM8 when field service scheduling and invoicing is the job. Compare Contractor Foreman for construction PM; Jobber for overlapping trades. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

faq.question: Is ServiceM8 a project management / work OS tool?
faq.answer: No. ServiceM8 is an adjacent desktop workspace organizer. It wraps web apps into desktop shells — it is not a project tracker or work OS.

faq.question: How is ServiceM8 priced?
faq.answer: Free (1 user); Growing $29/mo; Premium $79/mo; Premium Plus $149/mo per company.

faq.question: Does ServiceM8 have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: Yes — a free plan is published. No free trial is documented on the pricing page. Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test ServiceM8?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
